verified_contracts: ClibanoRecipe record has one or two vanilla Ingredient entries exposed by getIngredients(); recipe matches uses NeoForge RecipeMatcher.findMatches, a shapeless bipartite matching process, not Forge ritual greedy pedestal order.

ClibanoRecipe.requiredEnhancer is Optional<Holder<EnhancerDefinition>>, not a HolderSet/tag. EnhancerDefinition.REFERENCE_CODEC only serializes holder ID while full EnhancerDefinition.CODEC serializes description/display_item/effects. Installed physical enhancer definition is already included in legacy inputFingerprint; preserve that hash shape.

ClibanoRecipe.residueChance Optional carries ResidueChance(type:Holder<ResidueType>,chance:double). ResidueChance.CODEC encodes ResidueType.CODEC, a RegistryFileCodec holder reference. Full ResidueType.DIRECT_CODEC embeds name Component and CombineInfo(required_amount:int,result:ItemStack). Recipe codec fingerprint alone does not pin referenced residue semantics.

Native finishRecipe consumes each selected physical input and resets cooking progress, then inserts/grows result, then calls private addResidue, then setRecipeUsed. addResidue first returns for ordinary FIRE; otherwise RNG nextDouble<chance calls residuesStorage.increaseType(type,1) and immediately sends SetClibanoResiduesPayload.

ResiduesStorage.increaseType(Holder<ResidueType>,int) has no owner/machine parameter; total>=64 returns, else min(64-total,amount) is merged. New credit should be tied to canonical storage/owner and verified native finish scope, never attributed to a nearby player.

ResiduesStorage.tick loops current holder map; if amount>=required it merges exact native firstsameitem/secondsameitem/empty output priority and subtracts required. Native same-item merge ignores components; existing guard must remain. Conversion does not remove zero-value entries.

ResiduesStorage.save uses MAP_CODEC unboundedMap(ResidueType.CODEC,Codec.INT) and writes native residues compound ID-to-count only. load clears map/total, then codec parses current registry holders and resultOrPartial may retain partial successes. There is no historical definition snapshot in native NBT.

ClibanoMainBlockEntity.saveAdditional only calls residuesStorage.save when totalAmount!=0 and level!=null. Thus an all-zero map is omitted from native NBT even if zero holder entries remain in memory; historical metadata must not treat zero amounts as unpaid stock.

Main loadAdditional invokes residuesStorage.load after inventory, soul_time,burn_time,cooking arrays, fire type and recipes_used. Existing AIA2 load HEAD preserves raw unread native residues before partial decode; save RETURN retains unread raw state. Keep this preservation path.

Native serverTick performs logic update/canSmelt, then residue conversion, then soul/fire logic, then cooking logic and fuel. Transitive/persistence preflight must precede any side effect; finish must recheck dependencies against historical paid lane snapshot.

Native consumeSoul reads enhancer.getEffects(CLIBANO), applies only MultiplySoulDurationEffect and does not call ConditionalEnhancerEffect.checkConditions. Preserve native behavior; dependency validation may whitelist supported condition classes but must not invent conditional semantics.
recommended_compatibility: Keep existing aia2_clibano_paid_v1 schema1 Lane(recipe,definition,input) and their hash algorithms unchanged. Store dependency proof in a separate strict versioned NBT extension indexed by lane, bound to same receipt and recipe.

Expand current BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getTag membership; never use memoized Ingredient#getItems or Named identity as reload proof. Reject custom Ingredient/unknown Value before invoking native matching.
Revalidate native shapeless 1/2 input matching using fresh current tag memberships. Two-slot overlap must allow swapped pair matching; Forge greedy input validation cannot be reused unchanged.

Snapshot required/installed enhancer definitions and referenced ResidueType direct gameplay definition with codec/native field bounds. Resolve every referenced holder against current registry. Document conservative pause for description/name/display edits if full codecs are hashed.

Old lane receipt without dependency proof may continue only if current supported recipe genuinely has no transitive dependencies; all15native defaults reference residues and13use item tags. Never infer paid historical dependency proof from current datapack.

Positive legacy residue counts without a historical witness must remain preserved but non-converting; current type ID cannot certify old combine price/output. Zero count carries no stock and can start a fresh native-proven batch.

Record/validate witness before native residue credit (and before immediate stream packet). Bind expected amount and old definition so unknown credit cannot be merged into certified stock. Clear/update witness only after actual accepted native conversion/credit; retain exact raw unknown schemas and partial-native decode data.

Any explicit recovery/discard of residue stock needs nearby same-team operator permission, bounded persistent backup, no result/refund, and must not be triggered by installer or generic reset. Existing cancelProgress deliberately preserves residues and should keep that behavior.
known_risks: RNG/output/input side effects can already have happened before addResidue; deny unsupported residue definitions in mayFinish/preflight rather than relying only on increaseType interception. No universal rollback claim.
Native residues STREAM_CODEC encodes holder registry references; stale/removed holders cannot be sent safely. New witness logic must not remove existing menuPayloadSafe checks.

New residue guard should define direct addon increaseType policy. Storage has no caller owner in signature; weak owner association/canonical access or scoped native finish is required before credit authorization.
Full Component/ItemStack codec cost is not globally bounded by after-serialization JSON limits. Structural budgets and TPS profiling remain distinct guarantees.
No exact optional Mixin weaving, actual datapack reload, JEI/UI, Survival or TPS run performed in this audit.
